args.sql: SELECT DISTINCT product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' as rc_status FROM products;
SELECT return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' as ship_fee FROM returns LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    r.casenum,
    r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' as ship_fee,
    fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' as restock_fee,
    fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' as relabel_cost,
    fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' as disp_cost,
    fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' as repair_est,
    p.product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' as rc_status
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag
JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
WHERE p.product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' = 'Non-compliant'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    SUM(
        (CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS numeric) +
         CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS numeric) +
         CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS numeric) +
         CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'disposal'->>'disposal_cost' AS numeric) +
         CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'repair_costs'->>'repair_estimate' AS numeric)) * 0.2
    ) as total_penalty
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag
JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
WHERE p.product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' = 'Non-compliant';

SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM returns r
JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag
JOIN products p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
WHERE p.product_traceability->'compliance'->>'regulatory_compliance' = 'Non-compliant';

SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(
        (CAST(r.return_details->'shipping'->>'fee' AS numeric) +
         CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS numeric) +
         CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'relabeling_cost' AS numeric) +

    ) AS numeric), 2) as total_penalty

JOIN financial_management fm ON r.casenum = fm.casetag
